system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: After each Worker's action, the system updates the state and generates a focused prompt containing only essential context for the next task
system_prompt_style.note: Workers receive role system prompts; task prompts regenerated from state each step.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Supervisor creates an Initial Plan based on the presented Raw Source Code.
env_context_strategy.note: Source files (setup.py, __init__.py, imported files) injected up front; agents also fetch remote content via tools. Closest value: raw source injection is not a file tree summary.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: CHASE avoids passing entire message lists and instead maintains all information in a central state variable.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the fetch_content_at_url tool retrieves remote content with size limits and format detection capabilities

tool_count.evidence_quote: we implement only essential tools, each designed for specific attack patterns commonly observed in malicious packages discovered on PyPI.
tool_count.note: Deobfuscator: decrypt_fernet_payload, decode_base64_payload, execute_python_code; Web Researcher: TavilySearch, fetch_content_at_url, inspect_domain_or_url_using_virustotal. Split across agents (3 each).

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: we implement only essential tools, each designed for specific attack patterns commonly observed in malicious packages discovered on PyPI.
edit_primitive.note: No file-editing tool listed; analysis task.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: a high-reliability multi-agent architecture that combines Plan-and-Execute workflow, specialized Worker Agents, and robust deterministic tools.
loop_primitives.note: Workers are tool-using agents; react inferred for workers.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Variables in the state include source codes, a log of executed sub-tasks, and pending analysis tasks, ensuring no critical findings are lost.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A single Supervisor agent maintains the global analysis perspective and orchestrates the investigation, while specialized Worker agents execute domain-specific tasks.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:

delegation_mechanism.note: Delegation via task prompts to worker agents; mechanism not detailed.

human_in_loop.note: Human review of reports proposed only operationally.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: instead maintains all information in a central state variable

self_verification.evidence_quote: the Supervisor's review of Worker outputs provides additional error detection opportunities.
self_verification.note: Supervisor is a different model (Qwen3:32B) than workers; could be llm_judge.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Table I shows the detection results after running CHASE a single time on each package in the evaluation dataset.
retry_policy.note: Retry on timeout used in evaluation and suggested as operational policy.

termination_condition.note: Supervisor decides completion and writes report; 20-min timeout also ends runs (see F3).
